reason: I might take the free 15-company sample, because it costs me nothing but a call, but I would not put EUR 1,500 down this month. Anything new like this goes to my partners, and I would need to see the list is real and talk to that past client before I even bring it to them.
objection: Every agency promises meetings. My buyers in freight buy on trust built over years, and I doubt cold emails from some warmed-up domain bring me a decision-maker who actually moves cargo with us. I also do not believe 3 hours. My people are already stretched, and someone will have to chase these leads.
would_change_my_mind: If the sample list had names I recognise as real shippers in my lane, and a logistics owner I can phone tells me the meetings turned into actual contracts and not just coffee chats.
